Generate a sanskrit verse in Anuṣṭubh meter based on a given meaning or theme while strictly following the metrical (?and rhyme) rules.

Rules of Chandas:
Syllable Rules:
LAGHU vowels: अ, इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ
GURU vowels: आ, ई, ऊ, ॠ, ॡ, ए, ऐ, ओ, औ
HRASVA vowels: अ, इ, उ, ऋ, ऌ
DEERGHA vowels: आ, ई, ऊ, ॠ, ॡ, ए, ऐ, ओ, औ
Syllable is marked laghu, guru and hrasva, deergha based on the vowel it contains.
Syllable containing anusvāra("ं") or visarga("ः") is always marked as guru.
Syllable that is followed by a conjunct consonant (saṁyuktākṣara)
is always marked guru.

The goal is to generate Sanskrit verse that follows the anushtup meter rules for the given input translation.
RULES:
Verse Rules:
The verse contains 32 syllables/akshara and 4 padas in total.
The verse is divided in 2 lines, each containing 16 syllables.
Each line is divided into 2 padas (quartets),each containing exactly 8 syllables.
The fifth syllable of every pada must be LAGHU or short.
The sixth syllable of every pada must be GURU or long.
The seventh syllable of the second and the fourth pada must be HRASVA
The seventh syllable of the first and third paada must be DEERGHA

Language:
The generated verse must be in sanskrit in Devanagri script.
The Input given is in the hindi.
Do NOT include English words, transliteration, labels, or explanations.

Output Format:
(Output exactly 4 lines, one pada per line. Nothing else.)
model_out: यथा गृहगतः पुंसः पतितं गृहमास्थितः ततोऽन्यत् तत एवान्यत् तद्वत् कालप्रचोदितः

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र किष्किन्धायां सुबुद्धिमान् हनूमान्प्राह सुग्रीवमेकान्ते कपिनायकम् ॥
hi: हा इसी समय किष्किन्धापुरीमें परम बुद्धिमान् हनूमान्जी ने वानरराज सुग्रीवसे एकान्तमें कहा ॥
